| | Friend,
---
| | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...
---
[](https://email.updates.conservativeinnovation.com/c/eJyUkUGOnTAMhk8TdjwRhySTBYuqT0hdzGy7RMYxEA0kNAmv169o5wLdWfbnT7L_n-_TO4Y9xPUDDx7oFaZcprrxnNInbZj3wDsvdeYtRD9BB7qV0IK7Mdn4gbxR0PAgrbFdD52CZhuUXpRxSFJZv4DXJNHRPJMB14NlbMJwmySAA9l1YB9uRqVBo1u00-zfRN9dp8fK5UEpFs4vrOHFIcZ0Vyk-KB3NPmy1nkWobwJGAWNhujI_MLJP9SYEjPXKMcS1PVOItb0KChjBae3YUYuq922PpFuUxrTSGTJvFlnyItRY0pWJJ0qehXp-__FhnbJagLnqMR3sw3UI9eQDw_7V_Lch1HPD7LF8Tki_vkaEx4lhjUI9S6gxrdP94iYP_vwd9j0UY0Xfrbfs7231v8N4DfAnAAD__wITmAk)

A book not about politics... but about peace.

**It 's called: _Stop, in the Name of God._**

Friend, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book.

It's not a culture war manifesto.

It's a call to stop.

To rest. To breathe. To return to God.

**Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. **

Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away.

Trust that God is in control.

Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship.

**In _Stop, in the Name of God,_ you'll discover: **

🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout

🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer

🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation

Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again.

Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth.

He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth...

For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal.

Friend, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage.

clean_body: Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. | | | | | Friend, | | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. Friend, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Friend, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... Hey, it’s Jason.

My team just updated me that we’re a bit behind where we need to be heading into the end-of-quarter fundraising deadline on New Year’s at midnight.

Pitch in to help us close the gap: http://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec25?amount=10 [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec25?amount=10]

Look, I’m not one to tell you the sky is falling when it isn’t. We’re close to reaching our goal, and there’s still some time for us to catch up — but we can’t afford to fall short.

In Congress, I’ve been focused on delivering results for Colorado families, holding the Trump administration and its allies accountable for their corruption, and helping build a new generation of leadership for our country.

But it’s made me the target of Republican attacks, including from the president himself.

Just a few weeks ago, Trump called for my execution. And then, he sent his hyper-politicized FBI and Department of Justice after me.

This is our very first major fundraising deadline since these attacks, so I’m counting on this team to help us present the strongest possible fundraising report to the Federal Election Commission and send a message that we won’t back down.

My work won’t stop — and this campaign won’t slow down — after this quarter ends. We have quite the uphill battle ahead of us to win back the House for Democrats and elect servant leaders who will join me in standing up to Donald Trump. But if we’re going to stay on track and close 2025 out strong, we need a substantial boost tonight.

Can you chip in to help us reach our final fundraising goal of 2025? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc-em-dec25?amount=10]

Charlie’s final message—support Turning Point USA & receive his last book.

| Peter,
---
| Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

body:
As 2025 comes to a close, we’re writing with a simple but urgent message: the race to represent California’s 34th Congressional District in Los Angeles in 2026 is truly competitive - and your support for the Lucero for Congress campaign today can make a crucial difference.

| | |
---
Dear Peter, As 2025 comes to a close, we’re writing with a simple but urgent message: the race to represent California’s 34th Congressional District in Los Angeles in 2026 is truly competitive - and **your support for the Lucero for Congress campaign today can make a crucial difference.** In **2022** , incumbent Congressman **Jimmy Gomez barely held on** in what should have been a safe Democratic district, winning by just a few thousand votes against a Democratic Socialist (DSA) candidate in the general election.[ ](https://www.luceroforcongress.com/r?u=YdxJRnQoLxdx5w_fcXXkzgzgVD9HSloEZGt_HSycDLG4aQ5WekOflbxX65dY3lKmlEHKPhx6k5fsRBvZ7Iqj9junzOTgHlJgPbNEVWlqlh6EmOQdO0WkkLT4WLCjQcsmU0u9JGs5E5HI843AivOQp5-U6QL8b-tbQPj1qggNBqU&e=39cdcb2fb7adda80e7fc66430579bb85&utm_source=luceroforcongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_request&n=1) Such a narrow margin shows that Jimmy Gomez is vulnerable. Fast forward to today, and we’re seeing a **three-way contest shaping up for the June 2026 open primary**. In addition to incumbent Gomez, we have **Angela Gonzales-Torres** , backed by far-left DSA networks, and **Rob Lucero** , a dynamic Democrat with a bold vision for job creation and economic renewal. **Coming in FIRST or SECOND in June matters.** California’s open primary system means that the top two vote-getters face off in the November general election, regardless of party affiliation. To beat “business as usual” politics in this district, we **must finish the 4th Quarter strong, both in dollars raised and in the number of supporters engaged. It means every dime raised before the end of the year is crucial.** 👉 [https://www.luceroforcongress.com/donate](https://www.luceroforcongress.com/donate?e=39cdcb2fb7adda80e7fc66430579bb85&utm_source=luceroforcongress&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=end_of_year_request&n=2)
1. **Jimmy Gomez said he wouldn’t take corporate or PAC money - but he did - big time.** In the 2024 general and primary elections, Gomez benefitted from almost $3 million in PAC money, including about $1.5 million from AIPAC. Haven’t we had enough of such dishonesty?
2. **Los Angeles has seen what DSA party members represent** because there are three of them on the City Council. Among other crazy and irresponsible ideas, they advocate for “abolition” - and they openly explain what they mean: to abolish the police force. Is this kind of insanity what we want in the US Congress?
3. **Rob Lucero is the real alternative who offers a fresh, results-oriented approach.****

## Don’t Fear the Reaper: How to Save Social Security
---
Peter Ohtaki — December 29, 2025
---
“The Old-Age and Survivors Insurance (OASI) Trust Fund will be able to pay 100 percent of total scheduled benefits until **2033**. At that time, the fund’s reserves will become **depleted** and continuing program income [payroll tax] will be sufficient to pay **77 percent** of total scheduled benefits,” according to the [2025 Social Security Trust Report](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6952f2854385e5046b5df67d&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ssa.gov%2Foact%2Ftrsum%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6952eecba0cd19636c737758&l=en-US&s=cEf9eZjsWNZmr63oJmcV47buxJA%3D).Nearing retirement after paying **12.4%** (employer and employee combined payroll tax) of my salary for four decades, **the last thing I want is to receive only 77% of scheduled benefits starting in 2033** \- damn right, it’s personal!
---
#### **Impact of baby boomers retiring**
The OASDI Trust Fund is **$2.5 trillion** at the end of 2024, accumulated from decades of baby boomers paying into the fund from payroll taxes exceeding the benefits paid to past retirees. Now that baby boomers are retiring, however, Social Security **paid out $1.3 trillion to 68 million retirees** in 2024, which exceeded the $1.2 trillion of payroll tax income from current workers, and **drawing on the trust fund by $104 billion in 2024**.
#### _**Problem:**_**Trust Fund invests in U.S. Treasury bonds earning only 2.50%**
Social Security does not run out of money if the Trust Fund runs out, as current workers payroll taxes fund benefits for retirees. However, due to the number of baby boomers retiring, only 2 workers pay for each retiree’s benefits. This shortfall, $104 billion in 2024, is paid by the Trust Fund which is the surplus that grew while baby boomers were working. In addition, Social Security benefits increase by the _**Consumer Price Index**_ for inflation, which is projected rising at **2.4% per year**. The 2.50% return on the $2.5 trillion Trust Fund is not adequate to fund the shortfall between payroll tax income and Social Security benefits paid out.
#### **Solution: S &P500 portfolio would extend Trust Fund to 2040**
The funding gap between payroll taxes and Social Security benefits rises from $209 billion in 2025 to $442 billion in 2032. The OASDI Trust Fund must fully invest in large cap stocks like most pension funds, rather than US Treasury securities, to extend the Trust Fund. Corporate AAA-rated bonds yield 5.27%. CalPERS, the California Public Employees Retirement System, has a 7.00% target return managed by a panel of investment advisors. Public pension funds and most well-managed 401(k) accounts achieve 6-7% returns from well-diversified equity mutual funds and ETFs.
---
|
---
| ChatGPT analysis of [_2005 Social Security Trust Report_](https://g3j1.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=6952f2854385e5046b5df67d&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ssa.gov%2Foact%2Ftrsum%2F&w=6619ff0a31aa07375378c596&c=b_6952eecba0cd19636c737758&l=en-US&s=cEf9eZjsWNZmr63oJmcV47buxJA%3D)
---
**IMHO, equity risk is now required to delay depletion of the reserve.** **The S &P500 index annual return of 10.6% since 2005 (included 2009 Great Recession crash) would delay Trust Fund depletion until 2040.** Some call this idea “privatizing” social security, but that’s a misnomer since public employee pension funds like CalPERS are managed this way.
---
|
---
| ChatGPT-created spreadsheet model using 2025 Trust Fund Report assumptions with interest rate as variable.
---
#### **Why seek equity risk for an extra 6 years?**
I’d much prefer if social security benefits weren’t cut until I’m 79 when my expenses are lower, rather than at 74! By 2040, most baby boomers will reach average life expectancy so its demographic bulge will return to fewer retirees.Finally, the projections underscore _**it would be better to make program changes sooner rather than later, so the Trust Fund could earn S &P returns to extend past 2040**_.

Earlier this year, they voted to pass the "big, ugly bill," which stripped millions of health insurance. People are losing healthcare, rural hospitals are struggling or closing, and their nurses, doctors and staff are losing their jobs.

Now, at the end of this year, Republicans are letting critical ACA subsidies expire. A recent study projects that one in four Americans enrolled in the ACA could lose their coverage if these subsidies are not extended.

**We can't allow Republicans to continue their attacks on our healthcare.**

I know I’ll need your support now more than ever if we want to make another stand to defend WA-08, flip the House blue, and get our government back on track to serve the American people. The $30,000 we will raise this month will go directly toward electing a Congress that will prioritize affordable healthcare for everyone.

Yet, in Congress, Republicans are doing everything in their power to make it even harder for Americans to access healthcare. Earlier this year, they voted to pass the "big, ugly bill," which stripped millions of health insurance. People are losing healthcare, rural hospitals are struggling or closing, and their nurses, doctors and staff are losing their jobs. Now, at the end of this year, Republicans are letting critical ACA subsidies expire. A recent study projects that one in four Americans enrolled in the ACA could lose their coverage if these subsidies are not extended. We can't allow Republicans to continue their attacks on our healthcare. Peter,

As we head into these final days of the year, I wanted to take a moment to share a few important updates about where this race stands:
* **_This district is changing in a real way._** With the passage of Proposition 50, tens of thousands of new voters are being added to CA-27. Many of them have never seen my name on the ballot, which means our outreach work in the months ahead will be critical. The work of introducing myself and earning their trust starts _now, NOT next fall._

* **_This seat is still one of the most competitive in the country._** Even with the new maps, election experts continue to rank CA-27 as a key battleground for House control. National Republicans know that flipping seats like ours is central to their strategy, and they are already preparing to invest heavily here.

* **_A Republican challenger is already in the race, backed by the GOP machine._** Earlier this year, a GOP challenger entered the race with a day-one endorsement from Mike Garcia -- the Republican incumbent I defeated in 2024. That was no accident. It was a clear signal that national Republicans want to flip this seat back and are preparing for an onslaught of outside spending and attacks in the new year.

* **_Early strength matters more than ever._** As a first-term Democrat holding a competitive district, what we report at the end of this year will shape how this race is viewed heading into the midterm election year by allies and opponents alike.

clean_body: | = = Peter, As we head into these final days of the year, I wanted to take a moment to share a few important updates about where this race stands: This district is changing in a real way. With the passage of Proposition 50, tens of thousands of new voters are being added to CA-27. Many of them have never seen my name on the ballot, which means our outreach work in the months ahead will be critical. The work of introducing myself and earning their trust starts now, NOT next fall. This seat is still one of the most competitive in the country. Even with the new maps, election experts continue to rank CA-27 as a key battleground for House control. National Republicans know that flipping seats like ours is central to their strategy, and they are already preparing to invest heavily here. A Republican challenger is already in the race, backed by the GOP machine. Earlier this year, a GOP challenger entered the race with a day-one endorsement from Mike Garcia -- the Republican incumbent I defeated in 2024. That was no accident. It was a clear signal that national Republicans want to flip this seat back and are preparing for an onslaught of outside spending and attacks in the new year. Early strength matters more than ever. subject: Ohio just made it harder to vote by mail

body:
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
Bolts: Ohio Bans Grace Periods for Mail Ballots, Fulfilling Trump’s Wishes [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=122925_3&amount=25]
Ohio just made it harder to vote by mail, Team .
Senate Bill 293, which was recently signed into law, repeals Ohio’s practice of counting mail ballots that are postmarked prior to Election Day but that arrive up to four days after polls close. Now, any ballots delayed in the mail that arrive after Election Day won't count in Ohio.
This follows executive orders from President Trump, who is against mail-in voting despite voting that way himself , and has called for ending these so-called grace periods for mail ballots everywhere. Ohio’s new law follows his lead, threatening thousands of votes in the process.
We've said it before and we'll keep saying it: Mail-in balloting is safe and secure. It's a nonpartisan way for eligible voters to make their voices heard in our elections. And now it's harder for them to participate in elections in Ohio, whether they're a military member voting from overseas, someone who is immunocompromised, in a nursing home, or any other reason for voting by mail.
Defending vote-by-mail is a crucial part of protecting our fundamental right to vote. Chip in with $25 or whatever you can today to support mail-in voting across the country >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=122925_3&amount=25]

Trump has long lied about mail-in voting. He's claimed mail-in voting contributed to his 2020 election loss, though no widespread fraud has been found. In fact, the one case of mail-in ballot fraud in Pennsylvania after the 2020 election was a man who was prosecuted for returning his dead mother's ballot for Trump .
The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.
In Ohio, this new law will result in thousands of ballots being thrown out. We know this because thousands of ballots were accepted in the grace period in previous selections, some of them making the difference in local elections -- like in Warren County, where several races came down to single-digit margins.
Being blunt: There is no good-faith reason to end the vote-by-mail grace period. Just like the other Trump attacks on our elections in general and mail-in voting in particular -- this is a partisan voter suppression exercise meant to codify MAGA's power in perpetuity.
Opponents of voting rights will go to any length necessary to stay in power. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can to protect mail-in voting nationwide and stop these suppressive policies >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=122925_3&amount=25]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

**But momentum alone won’t get us there. What will ensure we win is clarity about who we’re fighting for and what we’ll do with power once we have it.**
If Democrats take back the House, we can start making important changes. Together, we can:
* Hold Trump and his administration accountable for abusing their power
* Stop the endless culture wars that are designed to distract from rising costs and corporate greed
* Protect health care subsidies and keep building momentum for Medicare For All
* Pass legislation that _actually_ helps families afford housing, child care, and education

Flipping the House is how we deliver those solutions. It’s how we can begin to restore a government that works for working people, not billionaires and special interests.

name: Wes Moore
subject: re: the year ahead
body:
# [](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/8?t=1&akid=1134%2E1086043%2EbVDvG-)
[](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20251229-2.C9YKXa&refcode=em-20251229-2&t=2&akid=1134%2E1086043%2EbVDvG-)
Peter, it’s Wes.
I’ve been taking these final few days before the new year to reflect on what this past year has meant -- not just for me, but for Maryland.
Throughout 2025, Marylanders have been met with daunting challenges. From the job losses inflicted by this federal administration's deep cuts to federal agencies, to the continued onslaught of attacks on our fundamental American rights and freedoms, families across our state have overcome so much.
But in the face of 2025’s setbacks, we’ve risen to every single challenge. We met pain with progress. We led by example and proved that Maryland can be a state that serves all our people.
Together, we’ve created new good-paying jobs, cut taxes for veterans and the middle class, and stemmed the tide of violent crime. Now, our goals are more ambitious than ever. We’ve set out to make our public schools the best in America, end childhood poverty, and ensure more Marylanders can afford to live here, buy a home, and build the lives they deserve.
As we look toward 2026, it’s clear we have tough fights on the horizon. Donald Trump has already set his sights on me, and he and his powerful GOP allies are going to do everything possible to flip our state back to red come November. It’s going to be an uphill battle to keep their MAGA agenda out of Government House in this next election.
But this powerful team has never backed down from a fight. If our opponents want to tear down our accomplishments, _I say let them try._
**The single most powerful way we can prepare for the challenges that lie ahead is to invest in the size and strength of our campaign today -- right before our final deadline of the year. [If you can, will you donate $5 to support our reelection effort one last time before 2026?](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20251229-2.C9YKXa&refcode=em-20251229-2&t=3&akid=1134%2E1086043%2EbVDvG-)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.wesmoore.com/go/417?c0=wes-em-20251229-2.C9YKXa&amount=5&refcode=em-20251229-2&t=22&akid=1134%2E1086043%2EbVDvG-)**
Thank you for being by my side this year. Your support means the world to me.
Elevate,
Wes

body:
And Alexandria is different, too.
#
Can we be real with you for a moment?
We understand that a constant stream of emails asking for a contribution can sometimes get on your nerves. That’s okay. Real people wrote this email, we get them as well. We understand how people can get frustrated. _But let us explain why this is vital._
When we’re asking for your support, we don’t expect every person to give. But we ask because we know that when you can support the cause, you will. That’s how this transformative movement works.**It’s a whole lot of people doing their part to make something great.**
[We’re just two days away from our end-of-year deadline, and we’re hoping to hit our fundraising targets before then. The only way we can is through the support of small-dollar donors chipping in whatever they can. If you can, will you make a $3 contribution — or $5, or anything you can — right now? It’ll go a long way.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251229.SZFcZ2&refcode=em20251229-10489-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10489%2E2526796%2EG-l4ar)
**[Contribute $5](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251229.SZFcZ2&refcode=em20251229-10489-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=10489%2E2526796%2EG-l4ar)**
We’re not exaggerating: most members of Congress fuel their reelection campaigns by dedicating hours of their time asking rich donors for $500, $1000, or even $3300 donations.
**Alexandria is different.** This whole movement is fueled by online contributions like the ones we’re asking for in this email. With these contributions, we’ve built a campaign that is...
1. Raising resources, recruiting volunteers, and making calls to help elect progressive allies across Congress, and build a progressive majority.
2. Reaching out to communities across NY-14 and the country to spread awareness about the Green New Deal, how to influence local, state, and federal leaders, and more.
3. Raising money for community relief organizations, closing critical resources gaps that the federal government has left unfilled.
4. Working day and night to reelect AOC, defeat our Republican opponents, and show the world what we can do.

[If this movement is the model of what you want in our politics, please donate today.](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20251229.SZFcZ2&refcode=em20251229-10489-P_FND_EGR_GRM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=21&akid=10489%2E2526796%2EG-l4ar)
Thanks for reading,
Team AOC

name: Roy Cooper
subject: The stakes as I see them
body:
I’m counting on you.
|
# [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/2365?source=&t=1&akid=231%2E124072%2EMkRxZc)
**[Our team’s most important fundraising deadline of this campaign is in two days, and we’re still short of our $1 million online fundraising goal. We have to file a public report when this year ends, so if we fall short, our opponent and the pundits will know. We can’t let that happen. I urgently need you to donate $1 or more to help close the gap before time runs out.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3490?t=7&akid=231%2E124072%2EMkRxZc)** Hi Peter, We’re closing in on this end-of-quarter fundraising deadline (now just two days away), so I want to reiterate the stakes: → Our race is currently rated a TOSS-UP, and the closer we get to Election Day, the tighter we expect the polls to become. → The path to the U.S. Senate majority runs through North Carolina. What happens here will determine whether or not we can take back power for the American people. → That’s why Republicans see me as their top threat — and why they’re willing to spend any amount of money trying to defeat me. Experts even think this could become the first _billion-dollar Senate race_ in history. **Falling short of our goal would set us back significantly — both by giving our opponents an opportunity to seize the momentum, and by threatening our ability to take on the GOP’s money machine.** **[I’m personally asking you to invest $1 or more in our campaign, before Wednesday’s critical filing deadline, to close the gap to our goal.](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3490?t=8&akid=231%2E124072%2EMkRxZc)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/3491?t=9&akid=231%2E124072%2EMkRxZc)

Roy Cooper

* * *
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

# **Judge orders release of redacted transcript from sealed Tyler Robinson hearing**
Fourth District Judge Tony Graf Jr. ruled that the transcript and audio recording of a closed-door hearing involving Charlie Kirk's accused assassin Tyler Robinson **[can be released in redacted form](https://substack.com/redirect/f41267a1-cdad-4d6e-bded-9983076c7cff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , with 246 words redacted from the 80-page transcript that was released Monday afternoon, while the audio recording will take about two weeks to redact and release.

* **Robinson accused of fatal rooftop shooting at TPUSA event:** Tyler Robinson, 22, is accused of firing a single shot from a rooftop overlooking a Turning Point USA event at Utah Valley University on September 10, striking the 31-year-old conservative speaker and married father of two in the neck as he fielded questions in a campus courtyard, before allegedly fleeing into a nearby neighborhood and ditching the suspected murder weapon, a Mauser .30-06 rifle.

* **Robinson confessed to roommate and parents before surrender:** The suspected killer returned home to southern Utah, about a four-hour drive away, and allegedly confessed to his roommate and romantic partner Lance Twiggs--who is cooperating with investigators and has not been charged--and to his parents who helped convince Robinson to surrender to Washington County deputies, with Robinson facing seven charges including aggravated murder carrying the potential death penalty and due back in court January 16.

Last spring, I released my first book "[Chasing After The Wind](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27139963.13916.1.07a6d5d856019896a6fb84627b47c921)" and so many of you encouraged me to keep writing. _So I did..._ My 2nd book is now **FINISHED**! It's entitled '[DIVIDED: BREAKING FREE FROM THE DOUBLE LIFE](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27139963.13917.1.382ac0e1b55d4e48efa164d5e693a1e6).' **Pastor Paula White-Cain** wrote an _incredible_ Foreword and **Rabbi Jonathan Cahn** gave an _amazing_ Endorsement. In this, I open up about _my own personal struggles_ as a follower of Jesus and a Pastor. I share things that I've never shared publicly in hopes that it will speak to people who might be ashamed with the different struggles they have even as Christians and how to have victory. There are two of us in all of us but we're not destined to live **DIVIDED** forever. As a thank you for your support, I've got a promo code (**SHERIDAN**) that you can use to save 30% off the pre-order at checkout. You can visit: [https://clr.cm/qPKQ ](https://email.cloud2.secureclick.net/c/5961?id=27139963.13918.1.3bee5327099228c7cbca63245c9fffae)to get your SIGNED copy and start reading immediately with the **FREE e-book** that's included. I believe this book will help many people overcome the double life that far too many of us live. Thank you -Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer

---
Every one of us lives with tension - the tug-of-war between the two of us living in all of us. In DIVIDED, Pastor Jackson Lahmeyer gets real, raw, and deeply relatable as he opens up about his own struggles with pride, anger, and failure while chasing God's purpose. Through humor, honesty, and hard-learned wisdom, Lahmeyer invites readers to drop the mask, confront the "dark me" that keeps surfacing, and experience the transforming power of grace. This is not a polished preacher's pep talk-it's a gut-level, heart-to-heart conversation about what it means to follow Jesus when life gets messy. Drawing from the lives of biblical characters like Peter, Jacob and Paul, Lahmeyer shows that even the greatest heroes of faith had moments of weakness, doubt, and defeat. He unpacks the difference between remorse and repentance, explores how belief shapes behavior, and reveals how identity-not effort-is the key to lasting transformation. With vivid stories, relatable honesty, and the truth of Scripture, he reminds us that God isn't looking for the perfect version of you-He's after the real you. Because the moment you get real with God is the moment He starts making you new. If you've ever felt like you're living two lives-the public you that looks strong and the private you that's barely hanging on-this book is for you. DIVIDED will help you see that failure isn't final, temptation isn't sin, and your past doesn't disqualify your purpose. You'll laugh, you'll be challenged, and you'll find hope in the God who meets you where you are but never leaves you there. Honest, gritty, and full of grace, this book will inspire you to feed the right wolf, renew your mind, and finally live as the "you" God designed you to be.

body:
If we can get just 30 seconds of your time, we’d really appreciate being able to make this case before the FEC deadline hits.
# [](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1&akid=4293%2E582294%2EzuYXzq)
Our final FEC deadline of 2025 fast approaches. Campaigns are legally required to publish their fundraising report when the year ends. Whether or not that public report is strong or weak has big consequences for Chris Pappas’s ability to carry New Hampshire in 2026.
**Will you give us _30 seconds of your time_ to make a quick argument?**
**[Then you can decide if you’re able to make your first donation before the FEC deadline to win New Hampshire.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251229_3.GdqQxO&refcode=em20251229-3&t=2&akid=4293%2E582294%2EzuYXzq)**
**Our argument:**
**➀ The “Efficiency” Factor**
Your donations go much further in New Hampshire than in other competitive states. Because our state is smaller, a minor shift in a few key towns can swing an entire Senate seat. This makes New Hampshire the highest-value "ROI" state for Democrats looking to build a Senate majority.
**➁ The Psychological Deterrent**
Politicians and PACs scour these FEC reports. It's how they decide where to spend their money. If we post a strong fundraising number over these next 72 hours, **we can actually discourage right-wing Super PACs from investing here by showing them this seat isn't a pick-up opportunity.** Conversely, if we look weak, we invite an avalanche of national spending and dark money that will be tough to keep up with.
**➂ The 50.65% Reality**
We cannot take New Hampshire for granted. In 2024 Democrats only carried 50.65% of the vote at the top of the ticket. Every single county here shifted towards Trump and the Republicans. The GOP sees us as a top target for a reason. If we fall complacent, we lose our best chance at a Democratic Senate majority that can check Donald Trump.
–
**[For all three reasons, we’re begging you to make your first donation to Chris Pappas before the FEC deadline ends in just 72 hours.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20251229_3.GdqQxO&refcode=em20251229-3&t=3&akid=4293%2E582294%2EzuYXzq)**

This final stage is critical. We’ve set an ambitious goal, and we can only meet it if this grassroots team steps up together. Thank you for giving us a chance to make this case. We know how important your time is, and we really appreciate you.
Team Pappas
**New Hampshire is poised to be one of the closest Senate races in the country in 2026. Will you chip in today to help Chris stop the Republicans from flipping the Granite State red and expanding their Senate majority?**

clean_body: Let me quickly explain why I am asking for help again. | Fellow American - I will ask for your help one last time before the year ends, and we’re officially in the midterm Election Year. But let me quickly explain why I am asking for help again. We are less than 12 hours before our final deadline of 2025. We kept our 2024 campaign promises. We secured the border. We passed the largest tax breaks to American families. We’re making our nation safer. But here's the bad news: Democrats are already outraising us by millions. And right here in Montana, Democrats spent more per eligible voter than ever before in American history. Jon Tester raised over $90 million last cycle. Democrats lost their lone Montanan member in Washington, so we know they will stop at nothing to defeat me. Team Daines must kick off the 2026 Election Year on the right footing. That's why I've set an aggressive goal with my team. We must raise an additional $5,632 before midnight to meet our 2025 digital goal. Democrats have made clear their plans for our country if they win back the Senate majority next year: Open borders, gun confiscation, major tax hikes, and a war on American energy. They will undo all of our work - we must ensure President Trump has a Senate majority for his entire term! My final request of 2025 is to help me start the midterm Election Year by combating the massive spending from the Left. Thanks for standing with me, Steve Daines P.S. I know you've given so much this year, and no amount is too small. Please don't let us fall short when we're so close to achieving it. Steve Daines is a fifth-generation Montanan, life-long sportsman and father of four serving the people of Montana as their Senator. Steve is committed to always putting Montana first as he works to bring real change to Washington and fights for more jobs, less government and common sense solutions to get our country back on track. Senator Steve Daines | | Paid for by Steve Daines for Montana

| Fellow Patriot,

| Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud.

He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus.

He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness.

And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible.

I saw it up close -- _Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. _

But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything.

_**He started observing the Sabbath. **_

Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance.

_But as an act of obedience. _

As a way of saying, **_" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." _**

Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped.

He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield.

No email. No media. No work.

He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children.

It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much.

But over time, it changed him.

And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned...

clean_body: How Sabbath rest anchored Charlie’s life Charlie’s final message—support Turning Point USA & receive his last book. | | | Fellow Patriot, | Charlie Kirk lived fast. And he lived loud. He filled arenas. He lit a fire in the next generation on campus. He confronted lies and spoke truth with boldness. And he built a movement and a machine that few ever thought possible. I saw it up close -- Charlie moved at a pace most couldn 't keep up with. But in the middle of all the noise... he made a quiet decision that changed everything. He started observing the Sabbath. Not as a box to check. Not as a religious performance. But as an act of obedience. As a way of saying, " God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." Every week -- no matter what -- Charlie stopped. He turned off the noise. He stepped away from the battlefield. No email. No media. No work. He gave his full attention fully to God, his wife Erika, and his children. It was hard at first -- for someone who carried so much. But over time, it changed him. And before he was assassinated, he wrote a book about what he had learned... | | This was Charlie's final message. His final act of trust. A book not about politics... but about peace. It 's called: Stop, in the Name of God. | | Fellow Patriot, like I mentioned, this isn't a political book. It's not a culture war manifesto. It's a call to stop. To rest. To breathe. To return to God. Because Charlie believed America hadn 't just forgotten truth... It had forgotten trust. Trust that the world keeps spinning when you step away. Trust that God is in control. Trust that rest is not weakness -- it's worship. In Stop, in the Name of God, you'll discover: 🔥 How Charlie reclaimed the Sabbath in a world built on burnout 🔥 What sacred rest gave back to him -- as a father, husband, and believer 🔥 Why he believed this message could spark revival in a restless generation Charlie wrote this book because he knew what it meant to nearly lose his peace -- and what it felt like to find it again. That's the heartbeat of his final message. | | Charlie Kirk didn't waste his time on earth. He left behind a family. He left behind a movement. And he left behind this truth... For anyone ready to step off the treadmill... and walk back toward what's eternal. Fellow Patriot, thank you -- in advance -- for helping reach the next generation with truth, faith, and moral courage. These are the very things Charlie gave his life for. May the message he left behind lead you -- just as it led him -- to a deeper trust in God... A stronger love for your family... subject: Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak, but I have not lost my voice.

body:

#

Friend,
Fourteen years ago, a gunman shot me in the head while I was meeting with constituents in front of a grocery store in Tucson.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251229-1-ex&t=1&akid=11144%2E3935704%2EoSfgSW)
Because of the damage the bullet caused to the left hemisphere of my brain, where the language function sits, I have aphasia. This means that even though the words are in my head, I have a hard time getting them out.
**Aphasia may make it harder for me to speak. But I have not lost my voice.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251229-1-ex&t=2&akid=11144%2E3935704%2EoSfgSW)
The road to recovery hasn’t been easy for me, but I’ve never given up. In addition to speech therapy and physical therapy, I dedicate much of my time to riding my bike, playing my French horn, and practicing yoga. These activities have helped me so much in my recovery journey.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-q42025.UDsFRy&refcode=em251229-1-ex&t=3&akid=11144%2E3935704%2EoSfgSW)
I know sometimes the challenge of ending gun violence in our nation can feel overwhelming. When we see the headlines after a mass shooting — or when we remember the countless tragedies that don’t make the news every day — I know how hard it can be.
But friend, we cannot give up. I have found my recovery journey and the fight to end gun violence to be very similar. _Even on the hardest days, we can never lose hope._
Wednesday is our final FEC deadline of the year. Our FEC fundraising deadlines are a critical test for the gun safety movement, as both our adversaries and our allies will be looking to see if we have the resources to take on the gun lobby and elect gun safety champions.

name: LCV 2026 Task Force
subject: PLEASE REVIEW: Your 2026 Membership Status Enclosed
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTMzNDUxOTQS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjM2MDI4NzAyNAS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_ We’re running out of time, Peter. Hundreds of people from around the country have stepped up today for Giving Tuesday, but we’re still running short of the 1,000 members we need to unlock an additional $100,000 for our work before midnight tonight. And with the Trump administration accelerating some of the most extreme anti-environment, pro-polluter attacks in modern history,falling short is simply not an option. We’re asking you, Peter: will you renew your LCV membership right now while membership is only $5 to help us unlock an additional $100,000 to oppose the Trump administration’s attempts to exploit our public lands and roll back climate progress? https://links.messages.lcv. This isn’t just about hitting a number. It’s about having the resources we need to challenge these increasingly reckless orders and attempts to shred environmental safeguards — and stop the polluter handouts that Trump and his allies are fast-tracking. RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/dmyWFLb~ Every single person who steps up today is critical to our efforts — here’s why this Giving Tuesday is so important: Trump is trying to erase the scientific and legal foundation of climate action. By dismantling the Endangerment Finding, which affirms that greenhouse gas emissions harm our health and welfare, Trump’s EPA would hand fossil fuel companies a free pass to spew climate pollution into our air. He’s also ending the program that required big polluters to report their pollution, making it nearly impossible to track what they’re spewing or hold them accountable.
Decades of established pollution protections are being peeled away. More than a dozen rules that keep toxic pollution out of the air we breathe and water we drink to protect our health are on the chopping block, tossed aside to allow fossil fueled power plants to cut corners and shift the burden of their damage onto our communities.
The Trump administration is giving away the Arctic to corporate polluters, working to allow more drilling in one of the planet’s last intact ecosystems. Mining roads carved through national parks and preserves. Fire-sale auctions in critical ecosystems. Hundreds of millions of acres of U.S. waters off Alaska potentially opened to drilling. It could do irreparable damage to wildlife, our climate, and Alaska Native communities. We’re working every day with our 30 state affiliates, organizing on the ground, exposing backroom deals and corruption, rallying voters, and defending the treasured and unique places that define our country. But meeting this moment requires resources — especially as we go up against big polluters and fossil fuel opponents. This $100,000 match challenge, and how many people step up this Giving Tuesday, will determine how hard we can push back. Peter, your renewal right now powers our work to protect people and the planet. Will you renew before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT to help keep this movement strong when it matters most? $5 is all it takes. https://links.messages.lcv. Every contribution brings us closer. And the clock is ticking. Thanks for standing with us, Chris Brooks
Vice President of Membership

**$5,** Peter.

**$5** because there is no path back from the brink of authoritarianism without defending this seat — the very seat that secured the Democratic majority in 2021.
You might think that a single $5 contribution can’t make a difference in an election as expensive and competitive as this one.
But as you read this, lots and lots of people are chipping in their own $5 — and it adds up fast when lots of people chip in.
